amenitiesDescription:
The amenity program is conceived as a vertical resort by Meyer Davis, layered across the tower's full height. At the base, Cafe Delano is an all-day signature restaurant. The resort-level pool deck features a wraparound pool, cabana lounge areas, and a poolside bar overlooking Biscayne Bay. Higher in the tower, the Delano Members' Club offers cultural and social programming exclusive to residents.

Wellness is anchored by The Source by Delano, a full-floor sanctuary with treatment rooms, sauna, steam rooms, cold plunge, private lockers, a fitness center, and a movement studio. Above 800 feet, the Sky Pool delivers one of the most elevated pool experiences in the Western Hemisphere. At the crown, roughly 850 feet up, Miami's first public observation floor features a cantilevered glass deck and a reimagined Delano Rose Bar. A sky restaurant rounds out the elevated dining program. Core residential services include 24-hour concierge, valet, security, and on-demand housekeeping, pet care, and property maintenance.
description: The first Delano-branded residence, anywhere. PMG's second Miami supertall rises 90 stories at 400 Biscayne Blvd. 421 residences in two ownership collections with a public observation sky deck. From $725,000.

investmentThesis: PMG's third supertall nationwide and second in Miami, positioned one block north of their nearly sold-out Waldorf Astoria. The dual-collection ownership structure is the key differentiator: Delano Collection units (floors 20 through 47) are eligible for short-term nightly rentals through the hotel operator, generating hotel-style income, a feature available in only a handful of branded Miami towers. Floors 49 through 75 hold a traditional luxury residential address with select deeded office suites. PMG's track record includes Manhattan's 111 West 57th Street and the sold-out E11EVEN Hotel & Residences. The original Delano Miami Beach is reopening in 2026 under Ennismore, extending the brand's global visibility at residential launch. Ownership includes Accor ALL Live Limitless elite VIP status across the global hotel portfolio. Groundbreaking expected summer 2027; delivery targeted for 2031.
name: Delano Residences Miami
residenceContent: The tower is organized into two distinct residential collections. The Delano Collection (floors 20 through 47) comprises 266 suites, one-, and two-bedroom residences, including lockout layouts. The Delano Residences (floors 49 through 75) offer 155 homes designed for long-term living, with select units including deeded, glass-enclosed private office suites. Interiors by Meyer Davis feature custom Italkraft cabinetry, fully integrated Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, Waterworks bathroom fixtures, contemporary lighting packages, smart home technology, and fully built-out closets. Floor-to-ceiling glass frames panoramic views of Biscayne Bay, Miami Beach, and the Atlantic from every residence.
